description: Bounded Shootout Toggle/NthToggle object construction, indirect dispatch, and exact stdout bytes.

pinned_source.license_note: The referenced C source has no explicit license notice; these are independently written ports.

source_bound.description: Construct and destroy one initial Toggle, make five stored-callback activation/value calls, construct/destroy n more Toggles, emit a blank line, construct and destroy one NthToggle, make eight stored-callback activation/value calls, then construct/destroy n more NthToggles. Negative n naturally skips both for-loops.
